messages:
emily: Heads-up  I'm opening a small PR to split the "Usage tiers" doc into two focused pages (metering + pricing) and to tidy SDK examples and dashboard links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1102. Need reviewers for snippets and link strategy.
tobias: Link?
emily: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1102/files
ranit: Quick scan: JS snippet still calls `client.legacy.sendUsage()`  update to `client.usage.report()` and add a note for pinned SDKs.
meera: We should avoid embedding internal grafana panel IDs publicly. Replace with `{{dashboard:usage_overview}}` tokens that resolve to friendly public URLs; ops-infra can maintain redirects.
ops-infra: +1 on tokens. File an ops ticket if you need a new mapping and we'll add a redirect.
emily: Good. Will swap IDs for tokens and add a short ops note in the PR.
tobias: Also be explicit about quota behavior. Replace "may be throttled" with an exact example (429 + quota_reason + Retry-After). Small backoff example for docs-tests would be helpful.
ranit: I'll draft the backoff snippet (docs-tests-friendly):
```
# docs-tests friendly backoff
for n in range(4):
    r = client.usage.report(payload)
    if r.status_code == 429:
        time.sleep(int(r.headers.get('Retry-After','1')) * (2**n))
    else:
        break
```
meera: For migration guide, add a compatibility shim showing `token_count -> token_total` mapping and note burst-window semantics. Keep legacy example but mark deprecated.
emily: Adding a migration checklist to the PR description (snippet updates, tokens, 429 example, compatibility shim, doctest, i18n markers).
l10n-bot: Reminder: wrap user-facing strings in `_()` so extraction picks them up.
docs-ci: lint queued: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/1102  note: lint will flag trailing whitespace in fenced blocks.
emily: Fixed whitespace in a follow-up commit.
docs-ci: staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/usage/tiers  preview shows split pages, deprecated banner, and tokenized links.
emily: Tests pass in docs-tests locally; queued CI passed. Merging after one final approval.
tobias: Add a short release-note line: "Split usage tiers: metering + pricing; updated SDK examples; dashboard links tokenized; migration checklist added."
emily: Added to release notes and merged. Thanks all. Closing thread.
